notes: Two isnads carry the same saying («قال صل عند رأس قبر الحسين»), so the second is a route, not a variant. The Imam is named inside the chain after «عن» and so is a narrator, not imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). The first route ends at البرقي and does not reach the Imam. «أبي» (relation) and «جماعة مشايخي» (unnamed) are in one level. The archive's three-route flag: the reading keeps two routes, as written.
